label_availability_preflight.beneficial_definition: An action is BENEFICIAL exactly when truth_recall_delta > 1e-12, where truth_recall_delta is recall(gold, baseline_top5 with the incoming document substituted at drop_rank) minus recall(gold, baseline_top5).
label_availability_preflight.neutral_definition: An action is NEUTRAL exactly when its gold-derived truth_recall_delta is neither positive nor negative under the canonical tolerance (delta = 0).
label_availability_preflight.harmful_definition: An action is HARMFUL exactly when truth_recall_delta < -1e-12, using the same gold-derived recall comparison.
required_fields_for_BNH: held-out query gold answer / relevant-document set
resulting substituted top-5 and its recall against gold
label_availability_preflight.canonical_P1_label_usage: B/N/H labels are used to construct supervised cross-class training pairs. Canonical inference computes ordered-pair probabilities from label-free feature differences and averages them; labels are subsequently used for evaluation/diagnostics, not to choose inference probabilities.
label_availability_preflight.blocking_reason: The requested +0.03/-0.03 transformation must know whether each ordered pair is BENEFICIAL->NEUTRAL or NEUTRAL->BENEFICIAL. Canonical action class is defined solely from the recall delta against the query gold answer. Thus selecting transformed probabilities for an outer held-out query would consume held-out truth inside the scoring function. Public/deployment queries likewise cannot be assigned these classes without public gold. The formulation is therefore oracle-only and non-deployable, not a policy_oof_strict executable policy.

notes: No transformation was applied, including to any single pair probability.
No transformed-score file or threshold report was created.
No proxy, predicted B/N class, rank heuristic, score threshold, feature-derived pseudo-label, or oracle diagnostic was substituted.
Original P3 and P3-R blocked results remain unchanged.
